logger.doc:name: Log POST Request
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { timestamp: now(), message: "Processing POST /flights request", payload: payload }]

validation:is-not-blank-string.doc:name: Validate flightId mandatory
validation:is-not-blank-string.message: Mandatory field 'flightId' is missing or blank.

validation:is-not-blank-string.doc:name: Validate airline mandatory
validation:is-not-blank-string.message: Mandatory field 'airline' is missing or blank.

validation:is-not-blank-string.doc:name: Validate source mandatory
validation:is-not-blank-string.message: Mandatory field 'source' is missing or blank.

validation:is-not-blank-string.doc:name: Validate destination mandatory
validation:is-not-blank-string.message: Mandatory field 'destination' is missing or blank.

ee:transform.doc:name: Map Request to DB Insert Parameters

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Flight Record
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO flights (flight_id, airline, source, destination, departure_time, arrival_time, available_seats, price, status) VALUES (:flightId, :airline, :source, :destination, :departureTime, :arrivalTime, :availableSeats, :price, :status)

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { message: "Flight " ++ vars.flightId ++ " created successfully.", flightId: vars.flightId }

logger.doc:name: Log POST Success
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { timestamp: now(), message: "Flight created successfully", flightId: vars.flightId }]

logger.doc:name: Log GET All Request
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { timestamp: now(), message: "Retrieving all flight records" }]

db:select.doc:name: Select All Flights
db:select.db:sql: SELECT flight_id, airline, source, destination, departure_time, arrival_time, available_seats, price, status FROM flights ORDER BY departure_time ASC

ee:transform.doc:name: Map DB Result to Flight List

logger.doc:name: Log GET All Success
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { timestamp: now(), message: "Retrieved flights", count: sizeOf(payload) }]

logger.doc:name: Log GET by ID Request
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { timestamp: now(), message: "Fetching flight details", flightId: vars.flightId }]

db:select.doc:name: Select Flight by ID
db:select.db:sql: SELECT flight_id, airline, source, destination, departure_time, arrival_time, available_seats, price, status FROM flights WHERE flight_id = :flightId

raise-error.doc:name: Raise FLIGHT:NOT_FOUND
raise-error.description: Requested flight record does not exist in database.

ee:transform.doc:name: Map Single DB Result to Flight Object

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var list = payload map (row) -> { flightId: row.flight_id default "", airline: row.airline default "", source: row.source default "", destination: row.destination default "", departureTime: (row.departure_time as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss"}) default "", arrivalTime: (row.arrival_time as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss"}) default "", availableSeats: row.available_seats default 0, price: row.price default 0.00, status: row.status default "Scheduled" } --- list[0]

logger.doc:name: Log GET by ID Success
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { timestamp: now(), message: "Successfully retrieved flight", flightId: vars.flightId }]

logger.doc:name: Log PUT Request
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { timestamp: now(), message: "Updating flight record", flightId: vars.flightId }]

validation:is-not-blank-string.doc:name: Validate airline mandatory
validation:is-not-blank-string.message: Mandatory field 'airline' is missing or blank.

validation:is-not-blank-string.doc:name: Validate source mandatory
validation:is-not-blank-string.message: Mandatory field 'source' is missing or blank.

validation:is-not-blank-string.doc:name: Validate destination mandatory
validation:is-not-blank-string.message: Mandatory field 'destination' is missing or blank.

db:select.doc:name: Check Flight Exists
db:select.db:sql: SELECT flight_id FROM flights WHERE flight_id = :flightId

raise-error.doc:name: Raise FLIGHT:NOT_FOUND
raise-error.description: Cannot update flight because it does not exist.

ee:transform.doc:name: Map Request to Update DB Parameters

db:update.doc:name: Update Flight Record
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE flights SET airline = :airline, source = :source, destination = :destination, departure_time = :departureTime, arrival_time = :arrivalTime, available_seats = :availableSeats, price = :price, status = :status WHERE flight_id = :flightId

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { message: "Flight " ++ vars.flightId ++ " updated successfully.", flightId: vars.flightId }

logger.doc:name: Log PUT Success
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { timestamp: now(), message: "Flight updated successfully", flightId: vars.flightId }]

logger.doc:name: Log DELETE Request
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { timestamp: now(), message: "Deleting flight record", flightId: vars.flightId }]

choice.doc:name: Choice Check If Record Was Deleted

raise-error.description: Cannot delete flight because it does not exist.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { message: "Flight " ++ vars.flightId ++ " deleted successfully.", flightId: vars.flightId }

logger.message: #[output application/json --- { timestamp: now(), message: "Flight deleted successfully", flightId: vars.flightId }]

logger.doc:name: Log GET by Source Request
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { timestamp: now(), message: "Searching flights by source city", sourceCity: vars.sourceCity }]

db:select.doc:name: Select Flights by Source City
db:select.db:sql: SELECT flight_id, airline, source, destination, departure_time, arrival_time, available_seats, price, status FROM flights WHERE LOWER(source) = LOWER(:sourceCity) ORDER BY departure_time ASC
